visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a white tabletop where a sheet of paper displays the chemical structure of caffeine. A person's hands are seen pointing at the diagram and then reaching for various colored spheres (blue, red, white, black) representing different atoms. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or indoor environment. (2) The hands begin connecting the colored spheres using small white plastic rods, gradually building a three-dimensional model that corresponds to the diagram on the paper. The background remains consistent, featuring the white surface and the instructional paper. (3) The scene shifts slightly to show a white box filled with a large variety of colorful spheres and connectors. The hands are seen assembling different molecular fragments, demonstrating the flexibility and ease of use of the model kit. (4) The final phase shows the completed caffeine molecule held up by the hands, followed by a thumbs-up gesture. The hands then continue to demonstrate the assembly of smaller, simpler molecules, emphasizing the educational and tactile nature of the product.
